title: The Driver Who 'Cuts In' Is Doing It Right (Zipper Merge)
description:
The driver who stays in the closing lane to the very end? In heavy traffic, that's what road agencies actually ask for 🚗

Using both lanes and taking turns at the merge point can make the backup up to 40% shorter. Honest catch: Minnesota's transport department says it won't get you through faster. It shortens the queue, evens out the lanes and cuts risky lane-jumping. In light traffic, merge early.

Early merger or zipper merger? Be honest 👇

Source: Minnesota Department of Transportation, zipper merge work zone guidance.
Animated with a real traffic simulation by Counterphysical. AI voice.
